_comment: Baseline experiment configuration. These are starting values for ONE controlled experiment, not claimed optima. Training scripts load this file and allow CLI overrides; every run logs the effective values actually used.

model._comment: Apache-2.0, ungated. Qwen2ForCausalLM (native in transformers). SDPA because FlashAttention-2 does not support the T4 (sm_75).

quantization._comment: QLoRA demonstration: NF4 frozen base weights + double quantization. Compute dtype is float16 because the T4 has no bf16 support. A 0.5B model does NOT require 4-bit to fit on a T4; quantization is used to demonstrate the technique under the assignment constraint.

lora._comment: Candidates only. train_qlora.py inspects the loaded model, prints every Linear/Linear4bit module name, and builds target_modules from candidates that actually exist. Any missing candidate is a hard error. Baseline = attention projections only (decision F); adding MLP projections would be a separate single-variable run.

sft._comment: Effective batch = micro_batch_size x gradient_accumulation_steps = 16. lr 2e-4 and max_grad_norm 0.3 follow common QLoRA practice. optim adamw_torch: optimizer state for ~2M adapter params is only a few MB, so paged 8-bit optimizers are not needed at baseline.

dpo._comment: Short DPO pass after SFT. Reference = the frozen SFT adapter loaded a second time under ref_adapter_name, NOT the adapter-disabled base model. Values here will be mapped onto the pinned trl==1.14.0 DPOConfig; the mapping is verified when train_dpo.py is written (Step 5).

data._comment: Split is by scenario FAMILY (whole families go to one side) and stratified: 5 eval examples per category, 4 eval examples per no-address location condition (6 conditions -> 24 eval no-address). Overall no-address = 6 x (6 + 4) = 60 / 400 = 15%.

evaluation._comment: Greedy decoding so the three models are compared on identical, deterministic inputs.
